αἰγιαλόν: Αἰγιαλός — Aegialus, the north coast of the Peloponnese (also αἰγιαλός ’seashore’); masc. acc. sg.
αἰγιόχοιο: αἰγίοχος — aegis-bearing, epithet of Zeus (meaning disputed, usually ’holding the αἰγίς’); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
αἰχμητάων: αἰχμητής — spearman, warrior; masc. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg., intensive with the subject: ’myself, yourself, himself’
αὖ: αὖ — again, in turn, back; adv., shorter form of αὖτε
αὖθ: αὖθις (elided αὖθ’) — again, in turn, next; adv., epic by-form αὖθι (cf. αὖτε)
αὖτ: αὖτε (elided αὖτ’) — again, in turn, moreover; epic adv./conj.
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γέρον: γέρων — old man; masc. voc. sg.: ’old man!’
γέροντος: γέρων — old man, elder; masc. gen. sg. (ἁλίοιο γέροντος ’of the old man of the sea’)
γαῖα: γαῖα — earth, land; fem. nom. sg. (epic = Attic γῆ)
γαῖαν: γαῖα — earth, land; fem. acc. sg.
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
δ: δέ (elided δ’) — and, but · also the elided suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Ἄργος δ’ ’to Argos’)
δέ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Οὔλυμπον δέ ’to Olympus’)
διὶ: Ζεύς — Zeus, chief of the gods; masc. dat. sg. Διί
δύω: δύο — two; numeral, epic by-form δύω, indeclinable
δώματ: δῶμα — house, home; neut. acc. pl., elided (δώματ’ = δώματα) · also neut. nom. pl., subject: κλυτὰ δώματ’ ἔασιν ’his famous halls are’
δὲ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (οἶκον δὲ ’homeward’)
δῆμον: δῆμος — people, land, community; masc. acc. sg.
δῖαν: δῖος — heavenly, divine; fem. acc. sg., epithet of the sea (ἅλα δῖαν ’the divine brine’) · also fem. acc. sg. of a land (Ἤλιδα δῖαν ’heavenly Elis’)
εἴ: εἰ — if, whether; accented εἴ before an enclitic (εἴ κεν, εἴ ποτε, εἴ περ)
εἶχον: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 pl. (the form also serves 1 sg.): ’they held, occupied’ (of places)
εὐρὺ: εὐρύς — wide, broad; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’widely’ (εὐρὺ κρείων ’wide-ruling’)
θ: τε (elided and aspirated θ’ before a rough breathing) — and; connective particle
θανάτοιο: θάνατος — death; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
θεοειδὴς: θεοειδής — godlike in form; adj., masc. nom. sg.
θεὰ: θεά — goddess; nom. sg. · also voc. sg. in address: ’goddess!’
θωρήσσοντο: θωρήσσω — arm with a breastplate; impf. 3 pl. mid., epic -σσ- (= Attic θωρήττω): ’armed themselves’
κάρηνα: κάρηνον — head, summit; pl. mountain peaks; of a city, its towers or battlements; neut. acc. pl.
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, along; + acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἔκηα ’burned up’) · also + acc. in κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’ · also + acc. of purpose, ’for’ (κατὰ δαῖτα ’for a feast’) · also + acc. of respect, ’in’ (κατὰ θυμόν ’in heart’) · also + acc., distributive: ’by’ (κατὰ φῦλα ’by tribes’) · also + acc. of place: ’in, among’ (κατὰ ὑσμίνας ’in the battles’) · also κατὰ σφέας ’by themselves, apart’
κῆρ: κῆρ — heart; neut. nom./acc. sg.; as accusative of respect, χωόμενος κῆρ ’incensed in heart’
κῆρα: κήρ — doom, fate of death; fem. acc. sg.
κῆρες: κήρ — death-spirit, doom of death; fem. nom. pl.: ’the death-spirits’ (a different word from κῆρ ’heart’)
λίην: λίαν — very much, exceedingly; adv., Ionic λίην (= Attic λίαν)
λαοὶ: λαός — people, host; masc. nom. pl. (epic; Attic λεώς, pl. λεῴ)
λαὸν: λαός — people, host; masc. acc. sg.
λινοθώρηξ: λινοθώρηξ — wearing a linen corselet; adj., masc. nom. sg.
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μάλιστ: μάλα — very, much; superl. adv. μάλιστα, elided (μάλιστ’ = μάλιστα): ’most of all, especially’
μάχεσθαι: μάχομαι — fight (epic μαχέομαι); pres. inf. (Attic μάχεσθαι), + dat. ’fight against’
μάχης: μάχη — battle, fight; fem. gen. sg., after ἀπάνευθε
μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’greatly’ (μέγα νήπιοι ’greatly foolish’)
μέγας: μέγας — great, big; masc. nom. sg.
μέλαιναν: μέλας — black, dark; fem. acc. sg.
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
νέοι: νέος — young, new; masc. nom. pl. as a noun: ’young men’
νήπιος: νήπιος — infant, still a child, witless; masc. nom. sg.
ναιετάασκον: ναιετάω — dwell, inhabit; impf. 3 pl., iterative -ασκον and uncontracted (= Attic ᾤκουν): ’used to dwell in’
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him, her’ · also ὁ, ἡ, τό, masc. nom. pl. ’they’
οἳ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. pl., ’who’
οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl. · also demonstrative, with γε: ’they’ (οἵ γ’ ἀθέριζον)
οἶος: οἶος — alone, only; masc. nom. sg.
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὓς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. pl.: ’whom’
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; masc./neut. gen. sg.: ’whose, of which’ · ἐξ οὗ ’since, from the time when’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν, masc./neut. gen. sg.: ’his own’ (οὗ πατρός ’his own father’)
πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
πάϊς: παῖς — child, son; masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic παῖς)
πεδίῳ: πεδίον — plain, flat land; neut. dat. sg.
πεποιθὼς: πείθω — persuade; perf. πέποιθα: trust, rely on (+ dat.); perf. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’trusting’
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’
περὶ: περί — around; + gen.: ’beyond, above’, or adv. ’exceedingly’ · also preverb in tmesis ’all round’ · also adv. in tmesis with εἰμί: ’surpass’ (περὶ … ἐστέ) · also + dat. of place: ’around’ (περὶ δουρί ’around the spear’) · also with ἀμφί, both before an accusative, ’round about’ (ἀμφὶ περὶ κρήνην ’round about a spring’) · also prep. + acc. of place: ’around’ (περὶ Δωδώνην ’around Dodona’)
πλεῖστοι: πολύς — much, many; superl. πλεῖστος, masc. nom. pl.: ’in the greatest numbers’
πολλοὶ: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. pl.
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.; also adverbial, ’much, earnestly’
πολὺ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’much, by far’
ποσσὶ: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., epic ποσσί (= Attic ποσί)
ποτ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv., elided (ποτ’ = ποτέ)
πριάμοιο: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
πριάμου: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. gen. sg.
προπάροιθε: προπάροιθε — before, in front of; prep. + gen., also adv.
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
πω: πω — yet, up to now; enclitic adv., usually with a negative
πόδα: πούς — foot; masc. acc. sg., acc. of respect: ’in the foot’
πόδας: πούς — foot; acc. pl., accusative of respect · also acc. pl., direct object: ’feet’ (πόδας καὶ χεῖρας ’feet and hands’)
πόλεμον: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. acc. sg.
πόλεμος: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. nom. sg.
πὰρ: παρά (apocope πάρ, grave before another word) — beside, alongside; prep. + dat.: ’beside’ · also prep. + acc., ’beside’ (πὰρ ποταμὸν ’beside the river’)
σελλήεντος: Σελλήεις — the Selleis, a river near Ephyre; masc. gen. sg.
σοὶ: σύ — you (sg.); dat. sg.: ’to, for you’
στεναχίζετο: στεναχίζω — groan, sigh, resound with groaning; impf. 3 sg. mid./pass.
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (σὺν … ταράξῃ = συνταράξῃ ’throw into confusion’)
σῆμα: σῆμα — sign, mark; neut. nom. sg., subject: ’sign’
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’
τέκε: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= ἔτεκε)
τί: τίς, τι — anyone, anything; indefinite enclitic, accented τί before an enclitic; neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’at all, in any way’ · also interrogative τίς, τί: ’what? why?’ (τί κλαίεις ’why are you weeping?’)
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τερπικεραύνῳ: τερπικέραυνος — delighting in the thunderbolt; masc. dat. sg., epithet of Zeus
τηλόθεν: τηλόθεν — from afar; adv., ablatival suffix -θεν
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’)

τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοιόνδε: τοιόσδε — such as this, of this kind; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λαόν
τοῖσιν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’with them’ · also masc. dat. pl., ’among them, to them’ (τοῖσιν … μετέφη ’spoke among them’)
τρωσὶ: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl.
τρωσὶν: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl.
τρώων: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. gen. pl.
τρῶές: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. nom. pl., accented before the enclitic τε
τρῶας: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. acc. pl.
τρῶες: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. nom. pl.
τό: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg. ’it, that’, often with γε: ’that at least’
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also relative, fem. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὴν πρῶτον ἐπηπείλησ’ ’which he first threatened’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’

υἷε: υἱός — son; masc. nom. dual: ’two sons’
φίλοι: φίλος — dear, friendly; masc. voc. pl. (identical with nom.), in address: ’friends!’
φῦλα: φῦλον — tribe, race; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’tribes’
χερσὶ: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -σί (= Attic χερσίν)
χθὼν: χθών — earth, ground; fem. nom. sg.
ἀγλαὰ: ἀγλαός — splendid, shining, glorious; adj., neut. acc. pl. (ἀγλαὰ δῶρα ’splendid gifts’)
ἀγλαὸς: ἀγλαός — splendid, radiant; masc. nom. sg.
ἀγορήν: ἀγορή — assembly, gathering-place; fem. acc. sg. (Attic ἀγορά)
ἀγχοῦ: ἀγχοῦ — near, close by; adv. (by-form of ἄγχι)
ἀθάνατοι: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. nom. pl.: ’the immortals’
ἀκροτάτῳ: ἄκρος — topmost, outermost; superl. ἀκρότατος, masc. dat. sg.
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀμφίμαχος: Ἀμφίμαχος — Amphimachus, an Epeian leader (son of Cteatus); masc. nom. sg.
ἀμφενέμοντο: ἀμφινέμομαι — dwell around, live round about; impf. 3 pl. mid. (augment in ἀμφ-ε-)

ἀμύμων: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent (an old epithet whose exact force is uncertain); masc./fem. nom. sg.
ἀνθρώπων: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; masc. gen. pl.
ἀπ: ἀπό (elided ἀπ’) — from, away from; prep. + gen.
ἀπάνευθε: ἀπάνευθε — far away, apart, at a distance; adv., + gen.
ἀρχὸς: ἀρχός — leader, chief; masc. nom. sg.
ἀχαιοί: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχιλεὺς: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus; masc. nom. sg., by-form with single -λ- (Ἀχιλεύς)
ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg. · also ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγε): ’led’ · also ἄγω — lead; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’lead’ (μή μ’ ἄγε κεῖσ’ ’do not lead me there’)
ἄλλους: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. pl.
ἄντιφος: Ἄντιφος — Antiphus, son of Thessalus, a leader from Cos; masc. nom. sg.
ἄπο: ἀπό — from, away from; prep. + gen., accented ἄπο when it follows its noun (νεῶν ἄπο ’from the ships’)
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄρηος: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. gen. sg., epic Ἄρηος (= Attic Ἄρεως)
ἄριστοι: ἄριστος — best; superl. of ἀγαθός, masc. nom. pl.
ἄστυ: ἄστυ — town, city; neut. acc. sg.
ἅμα: ἅμα — together, at the same time; adv. · also prep. + dat.: ’together with’
ἐέργει: εἴργω — shut in, enclose; pres. 3 sg., epic ἐέργω (= Attic εἴργω)
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)

ἐντὸς: ἐντός — within, inside; adv., or prep. + gen.
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐοικότες: ἔοικα (perf. with pres. force) — be like, resemble (+ dat.); perf. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’like’
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’)
ἐπίκουροι: ἐπίκουρος — ally, helper; masc. nom. pl.
ἐπίστροφος: Ἐπίστροφος — Epistrophus, a Phocian leader (also adj. ’much-visiting’); masc. nom. sg.
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’)
ἐρχομένων: ἔρχομαι — go, come, march; pres. part. mid. gen. pl. masc.: ’of those going’
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐσσεύοντο: σεύω — set moving; mid. rush, hasten; impf. 3 pl. mid., epic augment with doubled σ (ἐσσ-): ’rushed’
ἔμμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
ἔναιον: ναίω — dwell, inhabit; impf. 3 pl. (the form also serves 1 sg.): ’they dwelt’
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’) · also ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ’hither and thither, this way and that’
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔχον: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἶχον): ’held’
ἔχων: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’holding’
ἕκαστος: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. nom. sg.
ἠΰτε: ἠΰτε — like as, even as; epic particle introducing a comparison
ἠγνοίησεν: ἀγνοιέω (Attic ἀγνοέω) — fail to recognize, not know; aor. 3 sg. act., negated by οὐδέ: ’did not fail to recognize’
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἡγεμόνευε: ἡγεμονεύω — lead the way, be leader (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg. (augment not visible on ἡ-)
ἡγεῖτο: ἡγέομαι — lead, go first (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’was leading’
ἡγησάσθην: ἡγέομαι — lead, go first (+ gen.); aor. 3 dual mid.: ’the two led’
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’)
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἤτοι: ἤτοι (also printed ἦ τοι) — truly, surely; affirming particle, often barely translatable at the head of a formula
ἥρως: ἥρως — hero, man of standing; masc. nom. sg.
ἦγε: ἄγω — lead, bring; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’led, brought’
ἦρχ: ἄρχω — begin, rule; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἦρχ’ = ἦρχε), + inf.: ’was first to (speak)’ · also elided ἦρχον, impf. 3 pl., + gen.: ’were leading’ (τῶν ἦρχ’ Ἀσκάλαφος καὶ Ἰάλμενος) · also elided ἦρχε, impf. 3 sg., + gen.: ’was leading’ (τῶν ἦρχ’ Ἀγκαίοιο πάϊς)
ἦρχε: ἄρχω — begin, rule, lead; impf. 3 sg., absolute: ’led the way’ · also + gen. of the people or ships led: ’was leading’ (τῶν ἦρχε … νεῶν)
ἦρχεν: ἄρχω — begin, rule, lead; impf. 3 sg., ν-movable, + gen.: ’was leading’
ἦρχον: ἄρχω — begin, lead, rule; impf. 1 sg.: ’I began, I led’ · also impf. 3 pl., + gen.: ’were leading’ (Βοιωτῶν … ἦρχον)
ἱσταμένη: ἵστημι — set, make stand; mid. stand, come to stand; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’coming to stand, standing’
ἴσαν: εἶμι — go, come; impf. 3 pl., epic: ’went’
ἷζε: ἵζω — sit down, take one’s seat; impf. 3 sg.: ’sat down’
ὁμηγερέες: ὁμηγερής — gathered together, assembled; masc. nom. pl.
ὁππότε: ὁππότε — when; temporal conj., epic doubled π (= ὁπότε)
ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄζος: ὄζος — branch, shoot; fig. scion, offshoot; masc. nom. sg.
ὄρος: ὄρος — mountain; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg.
ὅθεν: ὅθεν — from where, whence; relative adv.
ὅθι: ὅθι — where; epic relative adverb (= Attic οὗ)
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; + gen.: ’from under’ (ὑπ’ ἀνθερεῶνος) · also + gen. of the agent or cause, ’under’ (ἀϋσάντων ὑπ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’as the Achaeans shouted’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπ’ Ἀδμήτῳ τέκε ’bore to Admetus’)
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’)
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’)
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’)
ὦκα: ὦκα — quickly, swiftly; adv., from ὠκύς
ὧδε: ὧδε — in this place, in this way, thus; adv.
ᾔδεε: οἶδα — know; plpf. (impf. in sense) 3 sg., epic ᾔδεε (= Attic ᾔδει): ’knew’
ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative, masc./neut. dat. sg.: ’to whom’ · also possessive, ’his own’
ῥέξαι: ῥέζω — do, perform, esp. offer sacrifice; aor. inf. act.: ’to offer’
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
